fields.name: Patient Last Name
fields.rationale_for_inclusion: Core identifier for patient matching, deduplication, and linking reports to existing public health records; needed for case investigation follow-up.
fields.base_fhir_profile: US Public Health Patient 2.0.0
fields.ig_cardinality: Patient.name 1..*; Patient.name.family 0..1 (invariant us-core-6: family, given, or data-absent-reason extension required)
fields.notes: USCDI v3 element supported by certified EHRs. Free text, so no value set applies. Populate when known; otherwise use data-absent-reason.

fields.name: Patient First Name
fields.rationale_for_inclusion: Used with last name, address, and DOB as a primary patient-matching key and for contacting the patient during case investigation.
fields.base_fhir_profile: US Public Health Patient 2.0.0

fields.name: Patient Address
fields.rationale_for_inclusion: US Public Health (PH) requires an address because residence determines the reporting jurisdiction. US PH adds county (district) as Must Support for local health department routing.
fields.base_fhir_profile: US Public Health Patient 2.0.0
fields.profile_data_element: Patient.address (use, line, city, district [county], state, postalCode)
fields.ig_must_support: Yes (address, line, city, district, state, postalCode)
fields.ig_cardinality: address 1..*; line 0..*; city 0..1; district 0..1; state 0..1; postalCode 0..1
fields.value_set_name: USPS Two Letter Alphabetic Codes; AddressUse
fields.value_set_oid: No OID in FHIR IG; C-CDA State Value Set equivalent 2.16.840.1.113883.3.88.12.80.1
fields.code_systems_name: USPS Two-Letter Alphabetic Codes; FHIR AddressUse
fields.notes: If homeless, populate what is known and use the US PH Characteristics of Home Environment profile. Masking allowed via data-absent-reason = 'masked'.

fields.name: Patient Date of Birth
fields.rationale_for_inclusion: Key patient-matching element and needed to calculate age for age-stratified surveillance, case definitions, and age-specific interventions (e.g., pediatric cases).
fields.base_fhir_profile: US Public Health Patient 2.0.0

fields.name: Sex
fields.rationale_for_inclusion: Used for stratification by sex.
fields.base_fhir_profile: US Public Health Patient 2.0.0
fields.ig_value_set: US Core Sex value set: Male, Female, Patient Sex Unknown, asked-declined (binding: required)
fields.notes: Patient.gender (AdministrativeGender, 1..1, Must Support) is the only required sex-related field in US PH; the Birth Sex  extension (us-core-birthsex, 0..1) is also available but is no longer a USCDI requirement after US Core 6.0.
fields.piqi_mapping_notes: No exact PIQI equivalent: the workbook's US Core sex extension is not the same concept as PIQI birthSex or genderIdentity.

fields.name: Race
fields.rationale_for_inclusion: US PH makes race required for health disparities analysis.
fields.base_fhir_profile: US Public Health Patient 2.0.0
fields.value_set_oid: No OID in FHIR IG; PHIN VADS Race Category equivalent 2.16.840.1.114222.4.11.836
fields.code_systems_name: CDC Race and Ethnicity (urn:oid:2.16.840.1.113883.6.238); HL7 v3 NullFlavor (UNK, ASKU)
fields.notes: To mask, add data-absent-reason = 'masked' and set text to 'masked'.

fields.name: Ethnicity
fields.rationale_for_inclusion: US PH makes ethnicity required alongside race for disparities analysis.
fields.base_fhir_profile: US Public Health Patient 2.0.0
fields.value_set_oid: No OID in FHIR IG; PHIN VADS Ethnicity Group equivalent 2.16.840.1.114222.4.11.837 (verify)
fields.code_systems_name: CDC Race and Ethnicity (urn:oid:2.16.840.1.113883.6.238); HL7 v3 NullFlavor (UNK, ASKU)
fields.notes: To mask, add data-absent-reason = 'masked' and set text to 'masked'.

fields.name: Encounter Status
fields.uscdi_element: Not a USCDI v3.1 data element
fields.rationale_for_inclusion: Indicates whether the encounter is planned, in-progress, finished, cancelled, or entered-in-error. Lets public health tell active vs. completed visits, trigger report updates when an encounter closes, and exclude entered-in-error records.
fields.base_fhir_profile: US Public Health Encounter 2.0.0
fields.notes: Required by base FHIR and the IG; the required binding means only the defined codes are allowed, so receivers can rely on consistent values.

fields.name: Encounter Classification
fields.uscdi_element: Not a USCDI v3.1 data element
fields.rationale_for_inclusion: Identifies the care setting (e.g., AMB ambulatory, EMER emergency, IMP inpatient, OBSENC observation, VR virtual). Setting drives case definitions, severity assessment (e.g., hospitalization), syndromic surveillance, and routing rules.
fields.base_fhir_profile: US Public Health Encounter 2.0.0
fields.notes: Required on every Encounter; the extensible binding means ActEncounterCode must be used when a suitable code exists.

fields.name: Encounter Type
fields.rationale_for_inclusion: Describes the specific kind of encounter (office visit, ED visit, telehealth). Adds detail beyond class for case investigation and utilization analysis; coded for consistent interpretation across senders.
fields.base_fhir_profile: US Public Health Encounter 2.0.0
fields.code_systems_name: Describes the specific kind of encounter (office visit, ED visit, telehealth). Adds detail beyond class for case investigation and utilization analysis; coded for consistent interpretation across senders.

fields.name: Encounter Diagnosis
fields.rationale_for_inclusion: Central to public health reporting: diagnosis codes drive reportable-condition trigger matching, case classification, and surveillance counts. Linking the diagnosis to the encounter establishes when and where it was made.
fields.base_fhir_profile: US Public Health Encounter 2.0.0
fields.profile_data_element: Condition.code (linked via Condition.encounter); also Encounter.reasonCode / reasonReference for visit reason
fields.ig_value_set: US Core Condition Codes, QI-Core, MENDS
fields.code_systems_name: Central to public health reporting: diagnosis codes drive reportable-condition trigger matching, case classification, and surveillance counts. Linking the diagnosis to the encounter establishes when and where it was made.
fields.notes: This is a reference to a US Public Health Condition Encounter Diagnosis.

fields.name: Encounter Time
fields.rationale_for_inclusion: Establishes the timing of care, used for onset and reporting timeliness, outbreak timelines, MMWR week assignment, and length of stay.
fields.base_fhir_profile: US Public Health Encounter 2.0.0
fields.notes: Period start is generally expected for reportable encounters even though the IG allows 0..1.

fields.name: Encounter Location
fields.rationale_for_inclusion: Identifies the facility where care occurred, supporting facility-level surveillance, outbreak and cluster detection, jurisdiction determination, and follow-up with the reporting facility.
fields.base_fhir_profile: US Public Health Encounter 2.0.0
fields.ig_value_set: None on Encounter (reference). Location.type may carry facility type codes.

fields.name: Blood Pressure (panel)
fields.uscdi_element: Vital Signs: Systolic and Diastolic Blood Pressure
fields.rationale_for_inclusion: Groups systolic and diastolic readings taken together. Both components are required on every blood pressure observation.
fields.base_fhir_profile: US Core Vital Signs Profile 6.1.0
fields.ig_cardinality: code 1..1 (fixed); no top-level value – results go in the two required components
fields.ig_value_set: Vital Sign Result Type (code binding: extensible; profile fixes the LOINC code)

fields.name: Systolic Blood Pressure
fields.rationale_for_inclusion: Required component of every BP observation. If not measured, a data-absent reason must be sent; servers must support it even if they always send values.
fields.base_fhir_profile: US Core Vital Signs Profile 6.1.0
fields.profile_data_element: Observation.component:systolic – code = LOINC 8480-6; valueQuantity in mm[Hg]
fields.ig_cardinality: component:systolic 1..1; code 1..1 (fixed); value 0..1 – value OR component.dataAbsentReason required (vs-3)
fields.ig_value_set: Code fixed to 8480-6; unit fixed to UCUM mm[Hg]

fields.name: Diastolic Blood Pressure
fields.rationale_for_inclusion: Required component of every BP observation, paired with systolic.
fields.base_fhir_profile: US Core Vital Signs Profile 6.1.0
fields.profile_data_element: Observation.component:diastolic – code = LOINC 8462-4; valueQuantity in mm[Hg]
fields.ig_cardinality: component:diastolic 1..1; code 1..1 (fixed); value 0..1 – value OR component.dataAbsentReason required (vs-3)
fields.ig_value_set: Code fixed to 8462-4; unit fixed to UCUM mm[Hg]

fields.name: Body Height
fields.rationale_for_inclusion: Used for BMI, growth tracking and dosing. More specific codes (e.g., 8306-3 body height lying) MAY be added as additional codings.
fields.base_fhir_profile: US Core Vital Signs Profile 6.1.0
fields.ig_cardinality: code 1..1 (fixed LOINC); value[x] 0..1 – value OR dataAbsentReason required (vs-2)
fields.ig_value_set: Code: Vital Sign Result Type (code binding: extensible; profile fixes the LOINC code); unit: Body Length Units http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/ucum-bodylength (binding: required – cm or [in_i])
fields.value_set_name: Vital Sign Result Type; Body Length Units

fields.name: Body Weight
fields.rationale_for_inclusion: Used for BMI, weight-based dosing, growth and nutrition monitoring.
fields.base_fhir_profile: US Core Vital Signs Profile 6.1.0
fields.ig_cardinality: code 1..1 (fixed LOINC); value[x] 0..1 – value OR dataAbsentReason required (vs-2)
fields.ig_value_set: Code: Vital Sign Result Type (code binding: extensible; profile fixes the LOINC code); unit: Body Weight Units http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/ucum-bodyweight (binding: required – kg, g or [lb_av])
fields.value_set_name: Vital Sign Result Type; Body Weight Units

fields.name: Heart Rate
fields.rationale_for_inclusion: Core vital sign for acuity and severity assessment.
fields.base_fhir_profile: US Core Vital Signs Profile 6.1.0
fields.ig_cardinality: code 1..1 (fixed LOINC); value[x] 0..1 – value OR dataAbsentReason required (vs-2)
fields.ig_value_set: Code: Vital Sign Result Type (code binding: extensible; profile fixes the LOINC code); unit fixed to UCUM /min (verify)

fields.name: Respiratory Rate
fields.rationale_for_inclusion: Core vital sign; important for respiratory illness severity.
fields.base_fhir_profile: US Core Vital Signs Profile 6.1.0
fields.ig_cardinality: code 1..1 (fixed LOINC); value[x] 0..1 – value OR dataAbsentReason required (vs-2)
fields.ig_value_set: Code: Vital Sign Result Type (code binding: extensible; profile fixes the LOINC code); unit fixed to UCUM /min (verify)

fields.name: Observation Status
fields.uscdi_element: No – not a separate USCDI element
fields.rationale_for_inclusion: Tells receivers whether a measurement is final, amended, preliminary or entered-in-error, so erroneous or unverified vitals can be excluded.
fields.base_fhir_profile: US Core Vital Signs Profile (us-core-vital-signs), US Core 9.0.0 – profile OID 2.16.840.1.113883.4.642.40.2.42.68; base for all US Core vital sign profiles

fields.name: Vital Sign Type (Code)
fields.uscdi_element: Yes – Vital Signs data class (each vital sign is a USCDI element)
fields.rationale_for_inclusion: Identifies what was measured. LOINC is required where a code exists; additional or more specific codes (e.g., 8306-3 body height lying) and local codes MAY be added.
fields.base_fhir_profile: US Core Vital Signs Profile (us-core-vital-signs), US Core 9.0.0 – profile OID 2.16.840.1.113883.4.642.40.2.42.68; base for all US Core vital sign profiles
fields.ig_value_set: Vital Sign Result Type (binding: extensible); each derived profile fixes a specific LOINC code (see 'Vital Sign Profiles' tab)

fields.name: Result Value or Absent Reason (conditional)
fields.rationale_for_inclusion: Every vital sign needs either a value with a standard UCUM unit or a coded reason it is missing (e.g., patient refused, unable to obtain). The two cannot both be sent (rule obs-6).
fields.base_fhir_profile: US Core Vital Signs Profile (us-core-vital-signs), US Core 9.0.0 – profile OID 2.16.840.1.113883.4.642.40.2.42.68; base for all US Core vital sign profiles
fields.profile_data_element: Observation.value[x] (valueQuantity Must Support, UCUM) OR Observation.dataAbsentReason
fields.ig_cardinality: value[x] 0..1; dataAbsentReason 0..1 – one of them is required unless component or hasMember is present (rule vs-2)

fields.name: Component Code and Value (conditional)
fields.uscdi_element: Yes – e.g., systolic and diastolic BP
fields.rationale_for_inclusion: Used for multi-part vitals such as blood pressure (systolic + diastolic) and pulse oximetry (O2 flow rate, concentration). Each component needs a code and a value or absent reason.
fields.base_fhir_profile: US Core Vital Signs Profile (us-core-vital-signs), US Core 9.0.0 – profile OID 2.16.840.1.113883.4.642.40.2.42.68; base for all US Core vital sign profiles
fields.ig_cardinality: component 0..*; component.code 1..1 when sent; value or dataAbsentReason required per component (rule vs-3)
fields.ig_value_set: component.code: Vital Sign Result Type (extensible); component.value: Vital Signs Units (extensible)
fields.value_set_name: Vital Sign Result Type; Vital Signs Units
fields.piqi_mapping_notes: Partial mapping to vital sign code/value/absent reason. PIQI does not represent Observation.component grouping separately.

fields.name: Lab Encounter
fields.rationale_for_inclusion: Visit associated with the test.
fields.base_fhir_profile: US Core Laboratory Result Observation Profile, US Core 9.0
fields.piqi_mapping_notes: No corresponding attribute in the selected PIQI clinical model.

fields.name: Specimen Collection Time
fields.rationale_for_inclusion: Clinically relevant time, usually specimen collection. effectivePeriod SHOULD be supported for timed collections.
fields.base_fhir_profile: US Core Laboratory Result Observation Profile, US Core 9.0
fields.piqi_mapping_notes: Mapped by the workbook's element name to specimenCollectionDateTime. The workbook lists Observation.effective[x]; confirm that the source actually represents specimen collection time.

fields.name: Lab Result Performer
fields.rationale_for_inclusion: Who is responsible for the result.
fields.base_fhir_profile: US Core Laboratory Result Observation Profile, US Core 9.0
fields.profile_data_element: Observation.performer (US Core Practitioner – Must Support target)

fields.name: Result Interpretation
fields.rationale_for_inclusion: High, low, normal, abnormal flags; supports alerting and reportable-result triage.
fields.base_fhir_profile: US Core Laboratory Result Observation Profile, US Core 9.0

fields.name: Reference Range
fields.rationale_for_inclusion: Normal range used to interpret the result.
fields.base_fhir_profile: US Core Laboratory Result Observation Profile, US Core 9.0
fields.ig_cardinality: 0..* (needs low, high or text – obs-3; UCUM units – us-core-22)

fields.name: Specimen
fields.rationale_for_inclusion: Specimen type (blood, serum, urine). SHOULD be sent even when implied by the LOINC code, and SHOULD not conflict with it.
fields.base_fhir_profile: US Core Laboratory Result Observation Profile, US Core 9.0
fields.piqi_mapping_notes: No corresponding attribute in the selected PIQI clinical model.

fields.name: Test Name (text) [Additional USCDI]
fields.rationale_for_inclusion: Name of the test as performed; required for ONC certification testing.
fields.base_fhir_profile: US Core Laboratory Result Observation Profile, US Core 9.0

fields.name: Lab Report Status [Required]
fields.rationale_for_inclusion: Status of the overall report; drives whether effective time and issued time are required.
fields.base_fhir_profile: US Core DiagnosticReport Profile for Laboratory Results Reporting, US Core 9.0
fields.piqi_mapping_notes: Partial mapping to lab resultStatus; PIQI has no separate DiagnosticReport status attribute.

fields.name: Lab Report Category [Required]
fields.rationale_for_inclusion: Identifies the report as a laboratory report.
fields.base_fhir_profile: US Core DiagnosticReport Profile for Laboratory Results Reporting, US Core 9.0
fields.ig_value_set: HL7 v2 Table 0074 Diagnostic Service Section ID

fields.name: Lab Report Order Code [Required]
fields.rationale_for_inclusion: The test or panel ordered (e.g., CBC, basic metabolic panel).
fields.base_fhir_profile: US Core DiagnosticReport Profile for Laboratory Results Reporting, US Core 9.0
fields.ig_value_set: US Core Laboratory Test Codes (binding: extensible)

fields.name: Lab Report Patient [Required]
fields.rationale_for_inclusion: Who the report is about.
fields.base_fhir_profile: US Core DiagnosticReport Profile for Laboratory Results Reporting, US Core 9.0
fields.piqi_mapping_notes: No corresponding attribute in the selected PIQI clinical model.

fields.name: Report Effective Time [Conditional]
fields.rationale_for_inclusion: Clinically relevant time of the report (usually specimen collection).
fields.base_fhir_profile: US Core DiagnosticReport Profile for Laboratory Results Reporting, US Core 9.0
fields.ig_cardinality: 0..1 – required when status is partial, preliminary, final, amended, corrected or appended (us-core-8)
fields.piqi_mapping_notes: Partial mapping to lab performedDateTime; PIQI has no separate DiagnosticReport effective time attribute.

fields.name: Report Issued Time [Conditional]
fields.rationale_for_inclusion: When the report was released; important for reporting timeliness.
fields.base_fhir_profile: US Core DiagnosticReport Profile for Laboratory Results Reporting, US Core 9.0
fields.ig_cardinality: 0..1 – required when status is partial, preliminary, final, amended, corrected or appended (us-core-9)

fields.name: Responsible Lab / Performer
fields.rationale_for_inclusion: Responsible diagnostic service (performing lab).
fields.base_fhir_profile: US Core DiagnosticReport Profile for Laboratory Results Reporting, US Core 9.0
fields.profile_data_element: DiagnosticReport.performer (US Core Practitioner – Must Support target; Organization allowed)

fields.name: Report Results
fields.rationale_for_inclusion: Links the report to its individual result Observations.
fields.base_fhir_profile: US Core DiagnosticReport Profile for Laboratory Results Reporting, US Core 9.0
fields.profile_data_element: DiagnosticReport.result (Reference to US Core Laboratory Result Observation)
fields.piqi_mapping_notes: No corresponding attribute in the selected PIQI clinical model.

fields.name: Phone Number
fields.rationale_for_inclusion: US PH adds Must Support and makes telecom required so public health can reach the patient for case investigation, contact tracing, and result notification.
fields.base_fhir_profile: US Public Health Patient 2.0.0
fields.value_set_oid: Verify in VSAC (FHIR core value sets; canonical URLs above)

fields.name: Phone Number Type
fields.rationale_for_inclusion: US PH adds Must Support and makes telecom required so public health can reach the patient for case investigation, contact tracing, and result notification.
fields.base_fhir_profile: US Public Health Patient 2.0.0
fields.profile_data_element: Patient.telecom, sliced: telecom:phone (system = phone) and telecom:email (system = email); each with value and use
fields.value_set_oid: Verify in VSAC (FHIR core value sets; canonical URLs above)
fields.piqi_mapping_notes: Mapped to the telecom container; PIQI has no separate phone use/type attribute.

fields.name: Email Address
fields.rationale_for_inclusion: US PH adds Must Support and makes telecom required so public health can reach the patient for case investigation, contact tracing, and result notification.
fields.base_fhir_profile: US Public Health Patient 2.0.0
fields.profile_data_element: Patient.telecom, sliced: telecom:phone (system = phone) and telecom:email (system = email); each with value and use
fields.value_set_oid: Verify in VSAC (FHIR core value sets; canonical URLs above)

fields.name: Tribal Affiliation
fields.rationale_for_inclusion: Supports coordination with tribal health authorities, tribal data sovereignty, and surveillance of disease burden in American Indian / Alaska Native communities.
fields.base_fhir_profile: US Public Health Patient 2.0.0
fields.notes: Earlier US PH STU1 used its own us-ph-tribal-affiliation-extension; STU2 uses the US Core extension.

fields.name: Date of Death
fields.rationale_for_inclusion: US PH requires deceased[x] on every patient (US Core: optional) to support mortality surveillance and case fatality rates.
fields.base_fhir_profile: US Public Health Patient 2.0.0
fields.notes: IG guidance: if the patient is deceased, use the dateTime type set to the date of death; otherwise send deceasedBoolean = false. The same element also serves as the Death Indicator (USCDI+ Patient Vital Status).

fields.name: Suffix
fields.rationale_for_inclusion: Improves patient matching and deduplication (e.g., Jr./Sr., II/III in the same household). Send when known.
fields.base_fhir_profile: US Public Health Patient 2.0.0
fields.piqi_mapping_notes: No corresponding attribute in the selected PIQI clinical model.

fields.name: Encounter Disposition
fields.rationale_for_inclusion: Indicates the outcome of the encounter (home, transferred, admitted, expired). Supports severity and outcome tracking (hospitalization, death), case follow-up, and transfers between facilities. Example binding only, so local code agreements may be needed.
fields.base_fhir_profile: US Public Health Encounter 2.0.0
fields.value_set_oid: N/A (example binding; no required value set)
fields.code_systems_name: HL7 Discharge Disposition (http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/discharge-disposition); NUBC Patient Discharge Status (2.16.840.1.113883.6.301.5) commonly used in US

fields.name: Medication Category
fields.rationale_for_inclusion: Where the medication is used (e.g., discharge medication). Helps build discharge and community medication lists.
fields.base_fhir_profile: US Core MedicationRequest Profile, US Core 9.0.0
fields.ig_value_set: medicationRequest Category Codes (binding: required on us-core slice; example on others)
fields.code_systems_name: FHIR MedicationRequest Category (inpatient | outpatient | community | discharge)

fields.name: Reported (secondary source)
fields.rationale_for_inclusion: Flags that the record came from a secondary source (e.g., patient-reported). Servers SHALL support at least one form; clients both.
fields.base_fhir_profile: US Core MedicationRequest Profile, US Core 9.0.0
fields.piqi_mapping_notes: No corresponding attribute in the selected PIQI clinical model.

fields.name: Medication Encounter
fields.rationale_for_inclusion: Links the order to the visit or admission in which it was written.
fields.base_fhir_profile: US Core MedicationRequest Profile, US Core 9.0.0
fields.piqi_mapping_notes: No corresponding attribute in the selected PIQI clinical model.

fields.name: Date Written
fields.rationale_for_inclusion: When the prescription was written; supports timelines and adherence analysis.
fields.base_fhir_profile: US Core MedicationRequest Profile, US Core 9.0.0
fields.piqi_mapping_notes: No exact PIQI equivalent for MedicationRequest.authoredOn; medication statementDate and startDate describe different events.

fields.name: Dosage Instructions (SIG)
fields.rationale_for_inclusion: Free-text instructions exactly as given to the patient.
fields.base_fhir_profile: US Core MedicationRequest Profile, US Core 9.0.0

fields.name: Dose Timing
fields.rationale_for_inclusion: When the medication should be taken (e.g., twice daily).
fields.base_fhir_profile: US Core MedicationRequest Profile, US Core 9.0.0
fields.piqi_mapping_notes: No corresponding attribute in the selected PIQI clinical model.

fields.name: Number of Refills
fields.rationale_for_inclusion: Refills authorized after the initial fill; with quantity gives total supply.
fields.base_fhir_profile: US Core MedicationRequest Profile, US Core 9.0.0
fields.piqi_mapping_notes: No corresponding attribute in the selected PIQI clinical model.

fields.name: Reason / Indication [Additional USCDI]
fields.rationale_for_inclusion: Why the medication was prescribed. Required for ONC certification testing; servers SHALL support at least one of code or reference.
fields.base_fhir_profile: US Core MedicationRequest Profile, US Core 9.0.0
fields.ig_value_set: reasonCode: US Core Condition Codes (binding: extensible)

fields.name: Medication Adherence [Additional USCDI]
fields.rationale_for_inclusion: Whether the medication has been taken as instructed. Required for ONC certification testing.
fields.base_fhir_profile: US Core MedicationRequest Profile, US Core 9.0.0

fields.name: Dispensing Pharmacy / Performer [Conditional]
fields.rationale_for_inclusion: Who dispensed (e.g., the pharmacy).
fields.base_fhir_profile: US Core MedicationDispense Profile, US Core 9.0
fields.ig_cardinality: performer 0..*; actor 1..1 when performer is sent
fields.piqi_mapping_notes: No corresponding attribute in the selected PIQI clinical model.

fields.name: Authorizing Prescription
fields.rationale_for_inclusion: Links the fill to the original order.
fields.base_fhir_profile: US Core MedicationDispense Profile, US Core 9.0
fields.piqi_mapping_notes: No corresponding attribute in the selected PIQI clinical model.

fields.name: Quantity Dispensed
fields.rationale_for_inclusion: Amount actually dispensed (vs. amount ordered on the MedicationRequest).
fields.base_fhir_profile: US Core MedicationDispense Profile, US Core 9.0
fields.piqi_mapping_notes: No exact PIQI equivalent for dispensed quantity; doseQuantity describes the dose, not the amount dispensed.

fields.name: Dispense Date
fields.rationale_for_inclusion: When the medication was given to the patient.
fields.base_fhir_profile: US Core MedicationDispense Profile, US Core 9.0
fields.piqi_mapping_notes: No corresponding attribute in the selected PIQI clinical model.

fields.name: Mother–Child Linkage: Child Reference
fields.section: Maternal Child Linkage: Select At Least One Linkage Set
fields.uscdi_element: Not a USCDI v3.1 data element
fields.rationale_for_inclusion: Core of the MIHR linkage pattern: the mother is represented as a RelatedPerson of the child Patient. Lets researchers pull infant outcomes for mothers in a cohort. MIHR expects sources to link mothers and children via RelatedPerson and Patient.link.
fields.base_fhir_profile: RelatedPerson (US Core RelatedPerson profile, as used by MIHR; MIHR defines no RelatedPerson profile of its own)
fields.profile_data_element: RelatedPerson.patient (the child Patient the mother is related to)
fields.piqi_mapping_notes: No corresponding attribute in the selected PIQI clinical model.

fields.name: Mother–Child Linkage: Relationship Type
fields.section: Maternal Child Linkage: Select At Least One Linkage Set
fields.uscdi_element: Not a USCDI v3.1 data element
fields.rationale_for_inclusion: Identifies the person as the mother (or natural/gestational mother) so the link can be interpreted correctly. Although optional in US Core, it is effectively needed for the linkage to be meaningful.
fields.base_fhir_profile: RelatedPerson (US Core RelatedPerson profile, as used by MIHR; MIHR defines no RelatedPerson profile of its own)
fields.profile_data_element: RelatedPerson.relationship (e.g., MTH = mother; MIHR examples also use CHILD)
fields.piqi_mapping_notes: No corresponding attribute in the selected PIQI clinical model.

fields.name: Mother–Child Linkage: Mother Patient Link
fields.section: Maternal Child Linkage: Select At Least One Linkage Set
fields.uscdi_element: Not a USCDI v3.1 data element
fields.rationale_for_inclusion: Closes the loop: states that the mother Patient and the mother RelatedPerson are the same person, so the mother's own clinical record can be joined to the child's. If a source cannot link this way, MIHR requires a separate mother/child association map.
fields.base_fhir_profile: Patient (US Core Patient profile, mother) – MIHR defines no Patient profile of its own
fields.profile_data_element: Patient.link.other (Reference to the mother's RelatedPerson) with Patient.link.type = seealso
fields.ig_must_support: No (not Must Support in US Core)
fields.piqi_mapping_notes: No corresponding attribute in the selected PIQI clinical model.

fields.name: Newborn Encounter Linked to Delivery Encounter
fields.section: Maternal Child Linkage: Select At Least One Linkage Set
fields.uscdi_element: Not a USCDI v3.1 data element
fields.rationale_for_inclusion: Ties the newborn's birth encounter to the mother's delivery encounter, following FHIR's mother-and-newborn guidance (shown in the MIHR newborn encounter example). Lets researchers relate delivery events and complications to newborn outcomes such as APGAR or bilirubin.
fields.base_fhir_profile: Encounter (US Core Encounter profile) – MIHR defines no Encounter profile of its own
fields.profile_data_element: Encounter.partOf (on the newborn's Encounter, referencing the mother's delivery Encounter)
fields.ig_must_support: No (not Must Support in US Core)

fields.name: SDOH Assessment (screening question and result)
fields.uscdi_element: Yes – SDOH Assessment (Assessment and Plan of Treatment)
fields.rationale_for_inclusion: Identifies social needs, such as food, housing or transportation insecurity, that may affect chronic disease management. Supports analysis of care gaps and differences in outcomes.
fields.base_fhir_profile: US Core Observation Screening Assessment Profile (us-core-observation-screening-assessment), US Core 9.0.0
fields.ig_cardinality: code 1..1; value[x] 0..1; dataAbsentReason 0..1. For an individual question without component or hasMember, a value or absent reason is required (us-core-2); do not send both (obs-6).
fields.ig_value_set: code: Screening and Assessment Survey Codes (preferred); answers: selected tool’s answer list; dataAbsentReason: DataAbsentReason (extensible)
fields.value_set_name: Screening and Assessment Survey Codes; tool-specific answer list; DataAbsentReason
fields.value_set_oid: 2.16.840.1.113762.1.4.1267.13 (question codes). Answer-list OID depends on tool; absent reason uses FHIR canonical URL.
fields.code_systems_name: LOINC (questions and coded answers); SNOMED CT where applicable; HL7 DataAbsentReason
fields.notes: One Observation per question/response. Include patient, status and survey category; retain screening date and identify SDOH category. Select domains and screening expectations for the pilot. Must Support does not itself require new screening. Missing results do not mean no social need. Sources in cell notes.
fields.piqi_mapping_notes: Partial mapping to assessment and resultValue. PIQI Health Assessments has no dataAbsentReason attribute.
